shared_elements: dense field of small repeated incised signs (script-like characters) covering the surface
writing organised in rows/registers across the surface
script overlaid on or adjacent to carved relief imagery
justification: Both surfaces are dominated by a dense, uniform field of small repeated wedge-like/script signs arranged in horizontal ruled lines covering the entire available ground, a fairly specific convention of text-as-decoration. The chief difference is that B also includes figural relief content — a human hand/fist gripping an object, drapery, and large rosettes — over and around which the inscription runs, whereas A shows only the inscribed field with no discernible figures.
